title: One Pawn Push
setup: White's knight has gone to a4, where its only squares are b6, c5, c3 and b2, and two of those are White's pawns.
hint: Two of the knight's jumps run into White's own pawns. Your a7- and d6-pawns already cover the other two.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{b5}} attacks the knight, which is already surrounded: b2 and c3 hold White's pawns, b6 is met by axb6 or cxb6, c5 by dxc5. The b5-pawn itself cannot be taken, so the knight simply falls.
